implemented_changes: T0 builds a minimal dependency map and same-wave ready-set for independent positive-benefit work.
Orchestrator parallelizes ready independent work, serializes dependencies, and joins before downstream commitment.
Independent nontrivial DOCX/XLSX mechanical inspections may use a process-parallel batch path only when expected net benefit is positive.
Simple tasks remain single-executor and required independent review remains unchanged.

performance_iterations.interpretation: Thread parallelism did not shorten this CPU-heavy inspection path and was replaced rather than retained for appearance.

Process-pool regression tests passed, but an inline-stdin benchmark could not be reloaded by macOS spawn. The benchmark harness was corrected to run from a real module file; no Cabinet quality gate was weakened.

performance_iterations.workload: 8 independent synthetic DOCX inspections with 24000 paragraphs each
performance_iterations.interpretation: The mechanical inspection segment improved materially for sufficiently heavy independent files. This is component-level synthetic evidence only and does not prove end-to-end real-office speed.

hosted_macos_module_diagnostic.known_runtime_issue: test_lifecycle_transaction_and_rollback can fail on GitHub-hosted macOS because the maintenance sandbox cannot initialize in that hosted process state.

not_yet_proven: Target Mac repo-native full-suite PASS for the v1.5.4 candidate.
Real-office end-to-end Before/After wall-clock improvement on QV-03 and QV-06 shaped work.
Two independent candidate reviews on the final immutable candidate.
A stable end-to-end ratio at or below the directional 0.70 target.
